text:
jess: FYI — Nimbus Systems sent the updated one-pager + logos for the joint solution brief. dropping links here: https://drive.company/nimbus/one-pager-v3.pdf and Figma: https://figma.com/file/nimbus-co-brand

mike: got it. quick ask — can we lock the Nimbus wordmark with our logo on the hero? they previously asked for equal prominence.

tara: @mike they included a co-branding guidance PDF: `Nimbus_Brand_Guide_2026.pdf`. notes about clearspace and min size. we should follow that exactly.

ravi: pinging legal on shared assets usage, but design-wise the lockup looks fine. can someone confirm we have high-res svg for both? the pdf has rasterized logos.

jess: I asked them for SVGs earlier today and they replied "attaching svgs in separate email". awaiting.

brandbot: [file uploaded] nimbus-logo-primary.svg

mike: quick content nit — in the one-pager the architecture diagram calls out "Redwood Dedicated" but the partner wanted it to say "Redwood Inference (Dedicated)" for brand clarity. small edit.

tara: noted. also they used a gray background behind the hero logo. Nimbus brand guide requires white background for co-branding panels. we'll need to update the mock.

jess: can we table the hero lockup until we get legal? in the meantime, I'd like design to produce two variants: (A) separate logos side-by-side with equal spacing, (B) stacked lockup with our name first. attach both to the reply to send to Nimbus for preference.

mike: will do. ETA EOD for the assets. will include alt text and thumbnail sizes: `thumb_600x200.png`, `web_1200x400.png`.

ravi: legal says draft usage ok as long as we don't imply partnership beyond "technology collaboration" and add this disclaimer: "Joint solution available through respective channels; trademarks remain property of their owners." can we add that small footnote?

jess: yes, add footnote and make it 10pt, gray 60% — matches our style.

tara: also noticed a typo in the customer quote on page 2 — "latency improvment" -> "latency improvement". fixing now.

mike: pushed updated Figma frames: https://figma.com/file/nimbus-co-brand/frames (frames 3 & 4 are the two lockups). replying to Nimbus with variants + use case ask.

jess: thanks. when you reply, include a short checklist to confirm their SVG license, approval of final lockup, and permission to use their customer quote (if it's a third-party quote). sample checklist:```- Confirm high-res SVGs and permitted uses
- Approve final hero lockup (variant A or B)
- Confirm quote attribution text
- Legal sign-off on footnote language
- Delivery timeline for final assets```

ravi: looks good. I'll do an expedited legal review once they confirm.

tara: ETA on publishing to marketplace listing after assets are final? Marketing needs 2 business days for upload + review.

jess: target publish next Tuesday if we get assets by Friday.

mike: tagging @Nimbus contact (cc in email) in my reply. drafting message now.

jess: perfect. wrapping up — I'll drop the final checklist and the brand-safe variants into the thread once Mike confirms upload. :tada:
